changeinfo.changes:
The following issues have been addressed in this patch:
  • The audio skipping and cutting out has been fixed.
  • The leaderboards will no longer show occasional empty entries.
  • S-Rank glitch has been corrected.
  • The area attack should clean all dirt on the screen reliably.
  • Possible crash with ending level and dying.
  • Fixed a rare crash when dying at the end of a level.
